definition: Unit keyword that contributes command dice without necessarily granting full command authority.
usage_example: Designer use: Adds capacity to a command-resource pool.

definition: Pre-battle or opening test used to determine which side begins with initiative.
usage_example: Designer use: Determines initial initiative or first activation.

definition: Order available through a particular commander or command model rather than the whole faction.
usage_example: Designer use: Spends command resources to apply commander-specific effects.

definition: State for a model or unit currently participating in the battle rather than destroyed or awaiting deployment.
usage_example: Designer use: Defines eligibility for rules, resources and effects.

definition: Model or unit controlled by neither main player and given special interaction rules by the scenario.
usage_example: Designer use: Represents civilians, creatures or other non-player battlefield actors.

definition: Designated model used as the reference point or authority figure within a multi-model unit.
usage_example: Designer use: Provides measurement, removal or command reference for its unit.

definition: High-speed movement action using the faster movement allowance of a unit.
usage_example: Designer use: Trades action opportunity for increased displacement.

definition: Standard movement action using a unit's normal movement allowance.
usage_example: Designer use: Provides ordinary tactical repositioning.

definition: Rule representing concentrated fire by allowing a limited number of attack dice to be re-rolled or otherwise improved.
usage_example: Designer use: Improves reliability through volume rather than raw penetration.

definition: Fallback procedure for tests whose nominal success threshold lies beyond the normal die range.
usage_example: Designer use: Allows extreme difficulty without changing the core die type.

definition: Spell resolved outside the normal battle sequence, usually during campaign preparation or aftermath.
usage_example: Designer use: Moves magical effects into campaign or pre-battle procedure.

definition: Spell whose legal target is the caster alone.
usage_example: Designer use: Restricts a magical effect to self-buffing or self-movement.

definition: Spell requiring direct contact with its target rather than ranged targeting.
usage_example: Designer use: Makes positioning and adjacency part of spell delivery.

definition: Spell whose effect applies across an area or to multiple eligible figures rather than one target.
usage_example: Designer use: Applies one magical effect to a zone or group.

definition: Test made to determine whether a spell is successfully cast and often how strongly it resolves.
usage_example: Designer use: Resolves spell success and may set a resistance threshold.

definition: Test using a will or mental-resistance characteristic to resist control, fear or magical effects.
usage_example: Designer use: Provides active resistance against mental or magical influence.

definition: Previously cast spell whose effect remains in force until cancelled, expired or otherwise removed.
usage_example: Designer use: Tracks persistent magical state.

definition: Ending an ongoing spell through its own condition, a counter-effect or voluntary cancellation.
usage_example: Designer use: Removes persistent magical state without necessarily undoing past consequences.

definition: Figure that joins a force for a limited battle or duration rather than becoming a permanent roster member.
usage_example: Designer use: Adds temporary manpower without permanent recruitment.

definition: Creature not controlled by either player's normal activation authority and resolved by its own behaviour rules.
usage_example: Designer use: Creates autonomous battlefield behaviour.

definition: Unit, model or system equipped to remove or neutralise minefield markers.
usage_example: Designer use: Provides specialist capability against mine obstacles.

definition: Action or procedure used to remove a minefield from the play area.
usage_example: Designer use: Reduces or removes a persistent hazardous obstacle.

definition: Model within a unit that is specifically counted as contributing to a shared action.
usage_example: Designer use: Defines which models add dice, mass or other values to a collective resolution.

definition: First model selected as the principal target of an attack before secondary targets or area effects are resolved.
usage_example: Designer use: Anchors targeting, visibility and secondary-effect geometry.

definition: Trait describing the model's current positional domain, such as surface, airborne or submerged.
usage_example: Designer use: Controls interaction eligibility between different spatial layers.

definition: Support system that improves repair attempts made by nearby eligible models.
usage_example: Designer use: Provides local assistance to damage-control resolution.

definition: Limited command-system effect that improves the strength or priority of another command effect.
usage_example: Designer use: Raises the chance or resistance threshold of a command intervention.

definition: Numeric rating representing a model's relative mass for collisions, grapples or mass-dependent effects.
usage_example: Designer use: Supplies a common physical scale for opposed movement and impact mechanics.

definition: Action roll whose dice pool is derived from participating models' combined mass to inflict disruption at range.
usage_example: Designer use: Converts physical mass into a non-contact disruption attack.

definition: Temporary high-speed state gained by engaging boosted propulsion and lost when disrupted or at phase end.
usage_example: Designer use: Marks exceptional propulsion performance and its vulnerability to damage.
